summary: Allbirds, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of an asset sale of its footwear business to an affiliate of American Exchange Group for $40.7 million in cash, adjusted for purchase price adjustments and including a $2.0 million deposit release. The board previously approved the sale; no advisors are named. $3.0 million of proceeds are held in escrow for 60 days to cover negative adjustments or representation inaccuracies. The company also disclosed a special dividend from the sale proceeds with a record date of June 25, 2026. Watch for the execution of the dividend and any post-closing adjustments.
